items.sentence: Each economic step, from farm to shop, adds a little cost.
Our class budget allows five thousand won for craft paper.
It is possible to finish this poster before lunch.
The bakery's monthly income grew after the new bus stop opened.
The water crisis ended when the town repaired the main pipe.
Trade brings coffee here and sends our machines to other countries.
Shopkeepers offer a smaller size to customers with less money.
We need one specific size, not just any large box.
Several coins rolled under the counter during the busy morning.
Severe cold last winter raised the heating cost sharply.
